skills.name: Plume Dart (流羽風)
skills.line: The plumes will stir your heart.
skills.description:
Kujaku-Myouou conjures darts of plumes to strike a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK and has 30% base chance of inflicting them with Disarm.
When she is performing in her Train-rattling form, this skill changes to Plume Razor. ;Train-rattling (开屏/開屏) : :'''General, Mark''': Cannot gain Peacock's Plumes. Increases her Crit by 40% and HIT by 75%. ;Disarm (缴械) : :Cannot use normal attacks and inflicted shikigami's equipped soul loses effect. When this effect is dispelled, decreases the enemy's normal attack damage by 20%, lasts for 1 turn. ;Base Chance :This chance can be affected by HIT.

skills.name: Plume Razor (流羽斬)
skills.description: Kujaku-Myouou turns her feather fan into a sword to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 150% of her ATK and has 100% base chance of inflicting them with Disarm lasting 1 turn. ;Disarm (缴械) : :Cannot use normal attacks and inflicted shikigami's equipped soul loses effect. When this effect is dispelled, decreases the enemy's normal attack damage by 20%, lasts for 1 turn. ;Base Chance :This chance can be affected by HIT.

skills.name: Ascendant (羽化)
skills.line: What doesn't destroy me makes me stronger.
skills.description: Exclusive effect. When At the start of battle and at the end of her turn, Kujaku-Myouou gains 1 Peacock's Plume stack. When the non-summoned ally with the lowest HP receives damage, she has a 30% base chance of inflicting Disarm on the source of the damage. Whenever she gains 5 Peacock's Plumes stacks. If she has 5 Peacock's Plumes stacks at the start of her turn, she ends the Plume Realm and consumes all Peacock's Plume stack to perform in her Train-rattling form, lasts for 3 turns. ;Peacock Plume (孔雀翎) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max 5 stacks. Each stack increases her HIT by 15%. When at max stacks, SPD increases by 50%. ;Train-rattling (开屏/開屏) : :'''General, Mark''': Cannot gain Peacock's Plumes. Increases her Crit by 40% and HIT by 75%. ;Disarm (缴械) : :Cannot use normal attacks and inflicted shikigami's equipped soul loses effect. When this effect is dispelled, decreases the enemy's normal attack damage by 20%, lasts for 1 turn.

upgrades.text: While performing in her Train-rattling form, removes all debuffs from herself. If a control effect is removed, duration for her Train-rattling form decreases by 1 turn.
While performing in her Train-rattling form, grants her immunity to debuffs and damage on her turn.
Whenever she gains 1 Peacock's Plume stack, dispels 1 debuff from all allies.
While performing in her Train-rattling form, each 1% of HIT increases her ATK by 1%.

upgrades.text: When cast, has a 40% base chance to inflict Disarm on all enemies for 1 turn.
'''Plume Realm''': the non-summoned entity ally with the lowest HP takes damage and has a 40% base chance to inflict Disarm on the damage source for 1 turn.
While the realm is active, damage taken reduces by 30%.

skills.name: Sundering Dance (雀舞斬棘)
skills.line: Only bloody feet can make world-shaking dance moves.
skills.description: Kujaku-Myouou has a 100% base of inflict Disarm on all enemies, lasts for 2 turn. Then she launches a 4-strike attack on all enemies, dealing damage equal to 45% of her ATK with each strike and inflicts 2 additional follow-up strikes, dealing damage equal to 45% of her ATK with each strike. After entering Display Stance, the skill doubles the number of attacks. ;Disarm (缴械) : :Cannot use normal attacks and inflicted shikigami's equipped soul loses effect.
